verdict.rationale: Okta documents extensive public REST APIs (SCIM CRUD API, Event Hooks REST callbacks, Admin Management APIs) and provides a free Integrator plan to test/automate against them, plus an official MCP server (okta-mcp-server) exposing these APIs for natural-language/agentic driving. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec and an llms.txt were not found (probes return 404), reducing AI-native self-discovery of the API surface.
